name: DAS KARTELL — Profit Basetool Design System

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: HAUSFARBE. The only logo colour besides white/black. Filled CTA (.btn--cta), headings, links, focus rings, HUD brackets, the 2px header/table-head rule. Black text on it (7.4:1).

tokens.name: color-white
tokens.usage: WEISS. Data readouts (--data-fg), selected-control text, text on danger/success fills.

tokens.name: color-bg-black
tokens.usage: SCHWARZ. Page canvas; text on the orange CTA.

tokens.name: color-accent-light
tokens.usage: ZIERFARBE HELL. Hover state of every orange element; active segment count; text on #141414 at 10:1.

tokens.name: color-accent-dark
tokens.usage: ZIERFARBE DUNKEL. Elevated/admin chrome (admin-mode header rule, admin chip border), deep accents. Not for text on black.

tokens.name: color-gray-1
tokens.usage: GRAUABSTUFUNG 1. Primary body text, labels, table text on #000, #141414 and #1C1C1C (11:1+).

tokens.name: color-gray-2
tokens.usage: GRAUABSTUFUNG 2. Control borders (3.55:1 on #000, 3.11:1 on #141414), scrollbar thumb, disabled fills, status dots. NOT as text: use color-gray-2-text.

tokens.name: color-gray-3
tokens.usage: GRAUABSTUFUNG 3. Decorative hairlines (row dividers, panel frames), row-hover fill, count-badge fill. Too faint (1.42:1) for control borders.

tokens.name: color-gray-4
tokens.usage: GRAUABSTUFUNG 4. Standard dark surface: header, footer, tables, cards, sidebar, .list-panel.

tokens.name: color-bg-dark-gray
tokens.usage: Alias of Grau 4 used across the shipped CSS (header, footer, tables, cards, sidebar).

tokens.name: color-surface-input
tokens.usage: Implementation half-step (not in the 2016 manual): input and table-head fill, control fill, so controls read above the surface.

tokens.name: color-dept-raumueberlegenheit
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Raumüberlegenheit (Space Superiority). Department tags/rows only; value must not be altered.

tokens.name: color-dept-forschung
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Forschung (Research). Department tags/rows only; as small text on black it reaches only 3.6:1.

tokens.name: color-dept-sub-radar
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Sub-Radar. Department tags/rows only; 2.3:1 on black, never as text.

tokens.name: color-dept-marinekorps
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Marinekorps (Marine Corps). Department tags/rows only.

tokens.name: color-dept-profit
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Profit. Department tags/rows only.

tokens.name: color-dept-search-rescue
tokens.usage: BEREICHSFARBE Search and Rescue. Department tags/rows only.

tokens.name: color-dept-combat
tokens.usage: Legacy alias: the shipped CSS called the teal Raumüberlegenheit "combat". Prefer the official name.

tokens.name: color-dept-research
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of Forschung. Prefer the official name.

tokens.name: color-dept-marine
tokens.usage: Legacy alias of Marinekorps. Prefer the official name.

tokens.name: color-danger
tokens.usage: Danger fill/border (same value as Sub-Radar): .btn-danger fill with white text, alert/chip borders. As text use color-danger-text.

tokens.name: color-success
tokens.usage: Success fill/border (same value as Profit): .btn-success fill with white text, alert borders, status dots.

tokens.name: color-warning
tokens.usage: Warning (same value as Search and Rescue): alert borders, in-progress status text on black.

tokens.name: color-info
tokens.usage: Info fill/border (same value as Forschung). As text use color-info-text.

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Cross-squadron / foreign-link highlight (.squadron-badge-foreign).

tokens.name: color-danger-text
tokens.usage: Danger as TEXT on #000/#141414 (5.3:1 on black): .text-danger, cancelled/rejected status, error toasts, price-down.

tokens.name: color-info-text
tokens.usage: Info as TEXT on #000/#141414 (6.1:1 on black): planned/open status.

tokens.name: color-success-text
tokens.usage: Success as TEXT on #000/#141414 (5.6:1 on black): active status, price-up, "abholbereit".

tokens.name: color-gray-2-text
tokens.usage: Muted TEXT on #000 (6.1:1), #141414 (5.3:1), #1C1C1C (4.9:1): secondary labels, placeholders, hints, field caps, units, inactive tabs. 4.27:1 on the #282828 row hover.

tokens.name: action-primary
tokens.usage: Filled CTA colour: the ONE primary action per context.

tokens.name: action-emphasis
tokens.usage: Outline secondary (.btn-outline).

tokens.name: action-neutral
tokens.usage: Ghost border: Grau 2 so the boundary reaches 3:1 (was Grau 3 until 2026-10).

tokens.name: data-fg
tokens.usage: Bright neutral data readouts (.data-value, kv values, facts bar). Orange is never a data colour.

tokens.name: surface-canvas
tokens.usage: Surface ladder step 0: page canvas; page head (eyebrow, title, CTA) sits here.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: Surface ladder step 1: the .list-panel work surface grouping toolbar, table and footer.

tokens.name: surface-inset
tokens.usage: Surface ladder step 2: table head, inputs, control fill.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Surface ladder step 3: row hover, .count-badge, control hover.

tokens.name: control-bg
tokens.usage: Resting fill of every non-CTA control (ghost, quiet-danger, segmented, pagination, inputs).

tokens.name: control-bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of controls.

tokens.name: control-border
tokens.usage: Border of every non-CTA control: ≥3:1 on canvas and panel (WCAG 1.4.11).

tokens.name: control-fg
tokens.usage: Control label text, 11.3:1 on control-bg.

tokens.name: control-selected-bg
tokens.usage: Selected segment / view switch: orange tint (≈#412E1D on #1C1C1C), never a solid orange block.

tokens.name: control-selected-border
tokens.usage: Selected segment border + 3px underline (the non-colour cue).

tokens.name: control-selected-fg
tokens.usage: Selected segment text, 12.9:1 on control-selected-bg.

tokens.name: color-danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of .btn-danger.

tokens.name: color-success-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of .btn-success.

groups.name: Headlines
groups.note: Lato, distinguished by weight, UPPERCASE and +0.05em tracking. Orange (color-primary).

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Lato Light 300 is the default body weight; Bold 700 for labels, nav, buttons.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Server join at 19:00 — meet on Teamspeak.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Tight gaps inside chips and icon buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Default gap between controls in a toolbar or filter row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Toolbar gap, footer padding, chip row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding, section gaps.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page-head bottom margin, larger section gaps.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Footer side padding, page-level separation.

tokens.name: touch-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for every interactive control (buttons, inputs, pagination, switches).

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Main content column cap.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Default for cards, inputs, buttons, modals, chips — the system is square.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Squadron pill badges only.

tokens.name: glow-primary

tokens.name: glow-primary-lg
tokens.usage: Large orange bloom: toasts, modals, CTA hover.

tokens.name: glow-danger-lg
tokens.usage: Red bloom: error toast, danger modal.

tokens.name: shadow-drawer
tokens.usage: Sidebar drawer separation (plain black, not depth styling).

tokens.name: shadow-dropdown
tokens.usage: Dropdown / popover separation.
